'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jan Westergard DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''ROPS (Revenge of Poo-Smith)'''. Printed name is Jan only. Transcription notes: Line 21 written ''Emperors Reach''; Line 27 written ''Omni Box Combo''; Line 38 written ''TTO''; Line 45 written ''Bleeder''; Line 46 written ''DDHACC''; Line 49 written ''Tatooine (EP1)''; Line 57 written ''Victory''. Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
